args.description: Get All User Subscriptions. Part of the Subscriptions APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

Returns voucher list totals (grand total and total due) for the current filters. Put type, date range, pagination, sort, search, branch, and voucherVersion on the query string. Send optional filter fields in the JSON body — never put type in the body (returns INVALID_PARAMETER). Part of the Get All Vouchers Balances APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

from.description: Start of voucher date range (dd-MM-yyyy). Optional.

to.description: End of voucher date range (dd-MM-yyyy). Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; required when the company uses branches. Optional.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Panel sends this on the query string. Default: 1. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Optional.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Allowed values: voucherDate, dueDate, voucherNumber. Optional.

q.description: Search on account name, uniqueName, or voucher number. Optional.

voucherVersion.description: Use 2 so the request is handled by the accounting microservice (same as the Giddh panel). Default: 2. Optional.

noteType.description: Optional credit/debit note subtype when type is a note list. Optional.

invoiceCount.description: Related invoice count hint for invoice list queries. Optional.

mail.description: When true, trigger mail export. Default: false. Optional.

sortBy.description: Sort field (mirrors query; panel also sends in body). Optional.

selectAllFields.description: Column/export field selection for list views. Optional.

args.description: List vouchers (sales invoices, receipts, payments, credit/debit notes) with pagination, date range, search, and optional JSON filters in the request body. from.description: Start of voucher date range (dd-MM-yyyy). Used with to. Optional.

to.description: End of voucher date range (dd-MM-yyyy). Used with from. Optional.

type.description: Which voucher list to load. Without a supported value the API returns no rows or INVALID_PARAMETER. Allowed values: sales, invoice, payment, receipt, credit note, debit note. Default: sales. Optional.

invoiceCount.description: Related invoice count hint used for sales/invoice lists (backend default 10). Default: 10. Optional.

q.description: Case-sensitive search on account name, account uniqueName, or voucher number. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Limit to a branch. Omit for company default / consolidated behaviour. Optional.

voucherVersion.description: Use 2 for accounting-microservice voucher APIs (same as Giddh panel). Default: 2. Optional.

noteType.description: Credit/debit note subtype when type is a note list. Optional.

mail.description: When true, trigger mail export. Default: false. Optional.
